title: pi-hole broken after updating pi-hole web to 5.18
body:
### The problem

After updating pi-hole (and FTL and AdminLTE), all sensors except the update information are no longer available.
Release notes AdminLTE: https://github.com/pi-hole/AdminLTE/releases/tag/v5.18

![sensors](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32911160/209077713-3ca1329c-c24f-4480-9155-e95a44c75235.png)



### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.12.8

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

pihole

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/pi_hole/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

comments.author: participant8
comments.body: For what it's worth, applying the changes in [this PR](https://github.com/participant22-ecosystem/python-hole/pull/14), fixed the issue for me. So if this is causing you pain that's a potential stop-gap.  It's just two lines in the __init__.py for hole.

comments.author: participant5
comments.body:
> For what it's worth, applying the changes in [this PR](https://github.com/participant22-ecosystem/python-hole/pull/14), fixed the issue for me. So if this is causing you pain that's a potential stop-gap. It's just two lines in the **init**.py for hole.

That sounds very promising. Could you tell me where to find this file? I'm running HA OS, maybe I need to login to the homeassistant container first.

_____________

Update: found it, solved it (temporarily until I can update HA Core to latest 2022.12):
1. `docker exec -it homeassistant bash`
2. `vi /usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/hole/__init__.py` --> apply changes --> save
3. restart HA

Total queries: 60K
queries blocked: 7K

These numbers on the webpage seem correct.. i guess..

In HA, the sensors itself show the numbers above correctly... but when you look at them in a graph (history, statistics, apex charts, mini graph card, the latter 2 custom) the show incorrect. 

60K becomes 60, 7k becomes 7.. so its in the difference between the . and the , i think. @participant5 .
In the Netherlands 7k is 7.376 with a . in the spot. With English it is 7,376 with a comma.. I think that causes problems somehow.

i think the api endpoint should be `summaryRaw` instead of `summary`  ... will update it in https://github.com/participant22-ecosystem/python-hole/pull/14

```diff
- params = "summary&auth={}".format(self.api_token)
+ params = "summaryRaw&auth={}".format(self.api_token)
```

I came across this today and it seems to me summaryRaw returns the correct data. Here's what changes I made to the file which seem to work as expected:

```
    async def get_data(self):
        """Get details of a *hole instance."""
        params = "summaryRaw&auth={}".format(self.api_token)      <----- add this line
